Status: complete (uncommitted in the worktree, as instructed — nothing committed, nothing pushed).

## Summary

Rolled out Inkuno brand-kit launcher + site art from `/Users/sachinkoli/Downloads/inkuno-brand-kit.zip` (read-only via `/tmp/inkuno-kit`; all repo derivatives are byte-exact copies — nothing redrawn). Palette is now kit-only repo-wide: grep for the old-mark colors (`#18221a/#ece7dc/#e8873f/#3a4b36/#0d140e`) returns zero hits. Forbidden slice untouched: no changes to `theme.rs`/`assets.rs`/`sidebar.rs`, `src/shell/*`, `Cargo.toml`, `Makefile`, desktop file, `Info.plist`, or `app_id` wiring.

## Files changed (worktree `/Users/sachinkoli/.hoocode/worktrees/noteapp/brand-icons`, branch `agent/brand-icons`)

Modified: `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg`, `docs/Inkuno.svg`, `packaging/macos/Inkuno.icns` (binary 113905 → 188981 bytes), `scripts/bundle-macos.sh` (+3 comment lines, `bash -n` clean). New: `packaging/macos/Inkuno.iconset/` (12 PNGs), `packaging/windows/inkuno.ico`.

## Per-surface mapping (kit source → repo dest)

- **Linux launcher** — `svg/inkuno-app-light.svg` → `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg` (byte-exact, `viewBox` preserved). Chose **light** rounded app variant because the kit's own macOS iconset is light-background (`#F5F5F2` sampled at interior pixels), keeping launchers consistent; blue is kit-marked optional. `Makefile:11` install line, desktop-id `Icon=`, and `app_id` wiring untouched and still resolving.
- **macOS** — `macos/Inkuno.iconset/*.png` → `packaging/macos/Inkuno.iconset/` (byte-exact, 12 files). `Inkuno.icns` rebuilt **genuinely** with Apple's `iconutil -c icns` on this mac host (kit README step 9) — verified `Mac OS X icon … "ic12" type`. `scripts/bundle-macos.sh:19-22` now documents the iconset as the source plus the exact regen command, so any mac runner can rebuild it; the `cp …/Inkuno.icns` consume path is unchanged and `CFBundleIconFile Inkuno` in `Info.plist` still matches.
- **Windows** — `windows/inkuno.ico` → `packaging/windows/inkuno.ico` (byte-exact, 7-icon kit ICO; confirmed the root `inkuno.ico` is a different, older 4-icon file). **Installer-manifest gap (reported):** no Windows packaging target exists — pipeline ships macOS+Linux only (`scripts/`, `Makefile`, CI have no `.msi`/winget/Squirrel manifest referencing any `.ico`; grep for `inkuno\.ico` repo-wide finds zero references). Wiring `packaging/windows/inkuno.ico` into a future installer manifest is still open.
- **Docs/site** — `svg/inkuno-mark-24.svg` → `docs/Inkuno.svg` (byte-exact simplified optical transparent mark; 24 vs 32 kit files differ only in `width/height` attributes, and `.brand img` renders at 24×24 in `docs/index.html:49`, so 24 is the exact optical match). `index.html` refs (`:11` favicon, `:161`/`:301` header/footer) already pointed at `Inkuno.svg` and resolve unchanged — no ref edits needed. `og:image` + `docs/site/inkuno.png` screenshot left as-is (below).

## Could not be done here + exact follow-up steps

- **Screenshots / og-image regeneration (follow-up):** `docs/site/inkuno.png`, `docs/screenshots/inkuno.png`, `demo.gif`, and README art are app-window captures, not brand files — impossible headless. Follow-up: on a display runner, `cargo run --release`, then `scripts/record-demo.sh` (per CONTRIBUTING, README GIF comes from that script), and re-export the 1720×720 shot to both `docs/site/inkuno.png` and `docs/screenshots/inkuno.png`.
- **ICNS rebuild on other machines:** already done here, but if the iconset is ever touched: `iconutil -c icns packaging/macos/Inkuno.iconset -o packaging/macos/Inkuno.icns` (macOS only; now also recorded in `bundle-macos.sh:19-21`).
- **Windows manifest:** when a Windows target lands, point it at `packaging/windows/inkuno.ico`.

## Open questions

1. Root `inkuno.ico` (old 4-icon mark) is now a confirmed unreferenced orphan — delete it, replace its bytes with the kit ICO, or leave it? Left untouched pending decision.
2. Single-file Linux icon can't satisfy the kit's "light-on-light / dark-on-dark" rule simultaneously; shipped light to match the macOS set — OK, or should the dark variant be the hicolor default?
3. `src/mcp/mod.rs:44` doc comment naming `com.inkuno.Inkuno.svg` still resolves (file kept) — no change made; flagging in case the later slice wants it updated.

Verified by: `cmp` byte-identity on all staged kit files, XML well-formedness + `viewBox` check on both SVGs, `bash -n`, repo-wide old-palette grep (clean), `git status`/`git diff --stat` showing only the intended 4 modified + 2 new paths.
